title: Functorial injective Cech total-complex map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U_i$ any family of opens, $F,G$ abelian sheaves, $I,J$ injective resolutions, and $\varphi:I^\bullet\to J^\bullet$ a cochain map. For the Cech double complexes [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction], define the map $\operatorname{Tot}(D(U,I))\to\operatorname{Tot}(D(U,J))$ by applying the Cech cochain functor to each $\varphi^n$, flipping to Cech degree first, and totalizing.
